'''Lommbo''' was a [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] working for the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] as a [[Clerk/Legends|clerk]]. He was responsible for renewing licenses. When [[Pyrron Nox]] attempted to renew [[Wrune Tsallin]]'s license by proxy, Lommbo informed him that Tsallin had been found dead, floating in the [[Ac'fren Spur]].<ref name="SSR" />
